prior_evidence.v2_notes: Three sources, three different dates for this one row, none matching GEM's Dec 2009 exactly: Sinopec's own disclosure says Jan 2009; thepaper.cn says full commercial launch Aug 31 2010; GEM says Dec 2009. Plausible reconciliation (not confirmed): Jan 2009 = first gas-in on an early completed section, Dec 2009 = a phased full-trunk connection milestone, Aug 2010 = declared full commercial operation/tariff start — large trunk pipelines commonly have staggered gas-in vs commercial-operation dates. Staging as REFS_ADDED because the YEAR 2009 is directly supported by a primary operator source, but tier is low and this needs human adjudication on which exact month GEM should carry, or whether StartYear2/StartMonth2 should record the 2010 commercial-launch milestone separately. Not calling this DEAD_LINK or leaving UNRESOLVED since real, live, on-topic evidence exists — just conflicting.
